note: The icons on the VR Portal home screen. Each entry: name, icon (an emoji or one or two letters), kind ("page" opens a web page, "window" opens a window the home page provides, named by app), url (a path on this site, such as "../Skeet-Game/", runs inside the home screen if the page supports it; a full https address opens as its own page) or app, an optional color (#rrggbb), and "about": a short line shown on its card (about 60 letters at most, to stay readable in the viewer). An entry that is not right is left out with a warning; the rest still load. "inside": true says the page can run inside the home screen (it uses engine 1.6.0 or later and starts by itself there).
